title: Transcription start sites from capped small RNA-seq of rat nucleus accumbens and prefrontal cortex
author: Francesca, Telese
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract total RNA from brain tissue
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from the 14 dissected rat brain regions (nucleus accumbens and prefrontal cortex).

steps.title: Size‑select 15–60 nt RNAs
steps.instruction: Run the total RNA on a denaturing polyacrylamide gel and excise the band corresponding to ~15–60 nucleotides to obtain size‑selected small RNAs.

steps.title: Prepare csRNA library (cap selection)
steps.instruction: From the size‑selected RNAs, perform cap selection, then decap the RNAs, ligate sequencing adapters, and retain the library for downstream sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare input library (10 % input)
steps.instruction: Take 10 % of the size‑selected small‑RNA pool, decap, ligate adapters, and keep the library for sequencing as the input control.

steps.title: Assess library quality by gel
steps.instruction: Run each prepared library on a gel electrophoresis to verify size distribution and integrity before sequencing.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq 500
steps.instruction: Load the libraries onto an Illumina NextSeq 500 and perform a 75‑cycle single‑end run.

steps.title: Align reads with STAR v2.5.3a
steps.instruction: Map the sequencing reads to the rat mRatBN7.2 genome assembly using STAR version 2.5.3a with default parameters.

steps.title: Call transcription start regions with HOMER
steps.instruction: Identify transcription start regions by running HOMER’s findPeaks tool on the aligned reads.
